kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
غللت (form I)
# غَلَلْتُ (ḡalaltu) /ɣa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# غَلَلْتَ (ḡalalta) /ɣa.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# غَلَلْتِ (ḡalalti) /ɣa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# غُلِلْتُ (ḡuliltu) /ɣu.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# غُلِ
